title: Motor imagery dataset for three imaginary states of the same upper extremity
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing three-class motor imagery of the same upper extremity: rest, hand grasping, and elbow flexion. Each participant completed 4 sessions of 20 trials per class, recorded with a 32-channel EGI HydroCel net at 1000 Hz. The dataset supports research on brain-computer interface classification of imagined movements within one limb, for example for rehabilitation and motor control.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded with EGI Geodesic Net Amps 400 series (Ag/AgCl sponge electrodes, Cz reference, 0.1-100 Hz online bandpass, impedance below 50 kOhm) at 1000 Hz. Visual cues instructed participants to rest, imagine opening and closing the fingers to grasp an object, or imagine moving the forearm up and down. Each trial lasted 3 s, with 20 trials per class in each of 4 sessions per subject.
